turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good afternoon, Northgate Insurance claims, my name is James Porter. This call is recorded. How can I help?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello. I'd like to report an accident. Someone drove into the back of my car this morning.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. First, is everyone alright? Was anyone hurt?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, nobody was hurt. Just shaken up. The car's in a bad way at the back, though.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm glad you're both okay. Could I take your name and policy number, please?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sophie Turner. The policy number is NGI-5520-0917.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you, Ms Turner. Which vehicle was involved? The registration, please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's KD19 XRM, a grey hatchback.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it. Where and when did the accident happen?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: About half past eight, at the lights on Mercer Street, by the library. I was stopped at a red light and he just didn't brake in time.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Did you exchange details with the other driver?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes. His name is Peter Lang, and his registration is BT21 HFO. He said it was his fault.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's helpful. Do you know who he's insured with?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: He said Crestline, but I didn't get a policy number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's fine, we can trace it from the registration. Were there any witnesses?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: A woman at the bus stop saw it. Her name was Grace Holloway. She gave me her number.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Could you read me the last three digits so I can attach it to the claim? We'll ask you for the full number by email.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It ends in 619.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. Did you take photos of the damage and the scene?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, about ten. The boot won't close properly and the rear light is smashed.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Please upload them through the link I'm sending you now. Is the car safe to drive?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I don't think so, with the light broken. Can you arrange a repair?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes. As the other driver admitted fault, we'll book you into one of our approved garages and arrange a courtesy car. Your claim number is 33-81402.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Thank you, that's a relief.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You're welcome, Ms Turner. A claims handler will call you within one working day. Take care.
